summary: Code is syntactically correct, imports are present, and the simulation implements the required functionality with reasonable logic and performance. A few minor issues were found regarding reproducibility (mixed RNGs), potential JSON strictness, and some metric definitions/unused variables.

issues.description: Non-deterministic random sampling is used in some places by calling np.random.* directly instead of the seeded self.rng, which can break reproducibility despite setting a seed.
issues.solution: Replace np.random.normal(...) with self.rng.normal(...) to ensure all randomness is driven by the seeded generator.

issues.description: adherence_probability_mean_over_time is computed only among agents who actually wore a mask that day, which may deviate from interpreting it as the population-wide mean adherence probability.
issues.solution: If the intended metric is population-wide mean adherence probability, use np.mean(wear_prob) instead of conditioning on self.wearing > 0.

issues.description: Mandated locations are reselected randomly every day, which can cause daily 'flicker' in requirements rather than a persistent set of mandated locations over the policy period.
issues.solution: Persist the selected mandated locations for the duration of the policy (e.g., select once on policy start and reuse until policy end).

issues.description: JSON output can include non-JSON-native values if any NaN or Infinity slips into results; while current code tries to avoid NaN, using json.dumps with allow_nan=False would enforce strict JSON.
issues.solution: Use json.dumps(results, default=float, allow_nan=False) and pre-sanitize any NaN/Inf values (e.g., replace with None or finite fallbacks) to ensure strict JSON compliance.

issues.description: Unused variable enforced_mask is created but never used.
issues.solution: Remove enforced_mask or use it meaningfully, e.g., for recording enforcement actions.

issues.description: Visualization is enabled by default and may block in some environments or be unnecessary in headless runs.
issues.location: main -> sim.visualize() when --no_viz is not set
issues.solution: Consider defaulting to --no_viz or using a non-interactive backend and saving figures to file instead of showing them.
